input_packet.case_brief: Sensitive parent/minor case where the anchor depends on named outside resources and the deck pressure may generalize them away.
input_packet.anchor_visible_candidate: Talk with RAINN, a therapist, or counsel before deciding whether to report. Keep the phone channel open unless a concrete tripwire fires, such as a request to meet, sexual images, threats, evidence of other minors, migration to hidden channels, or your daughter saying she feels pressured or afraid. Quiet behavior does not prove the risk is gone.
input_packet.deck_pressure_candidate: Use professional support and keep the safety plan active. Watch for tripwires and preserve communication boundaries, but do not assume quiet behavior means the risk has disappeared.

step6_output.answer_core: Talk with RAINN, a therapist, or legal counsel before deciding whether to report. Keep the communication channel with your daughter open and keep your safety plan active. Watch for clear tripwires such as any request to meet in person, sexual images, threats, signs of other minors being involved, attempts to move the conversation to hidden channels, or your daughter saying she feels pressured or afraid. Quiet behavior alone does not mean the risk has disappeared.
